title: Muryar da ke cikin Tsohuwar Yashi
intro: Daga cikin manzannin Allah na farko, akwai wanda sunansa ya bayyana a cikin Alqur'ani na ɗan lokaci amma yana da ma'ana. Wannan mutumin ya rayu tun kafin a aiko annabawan da yawa, kuma an san shi da gaskiya da haƙuri mai ƙarfi. Labarinsu gajere ne amma gadonsu ya dawwama a cikin tarihin madawwami. Wanene wannan rai mai daraja?
clues: Ni ɗaya ne daga cikin manzanni na farko, an ambace ni a taƙaice amma kuma ina da ma'ana a cikin Alƙur'ani.
An bayyana halina ta hanyar jajircewa ga gaskiya ba tare da wata shakka ba.
Ana ambatona a cikin littafin Allah a cikin waɗanda suka yi haƙuri da haƙuri.
Ayoyi kaɗan ne kawai a cikin Alqur'ani suka ba ni labarina.
Allah ya girmama ni ta hanyar da ta kebanta da ni, ba tare da raba ni da sauran annabawa ba.
An ɗaga ni zuwa wani babban matsayi, wani babban matsayi a cikin Alƙur'ani.

trial.label: Ma'anar Lokacin
options: Allah Ya daukaka ni zuwa babban matsayi
Na gina babban jirgi domin ceton mutanena
'Yan'uwana ne suka jefa ni cikin rami
Na rasa ganina saboda baƙin cikin da nake yi game da ɗana
trial.answer: Allah Ya daukaka ni zuwa babban matsayi

outcome.label: Daraja ta Allah
options: Babban tasha ba kamar sauran ba
Alkawari da aka kulla da Allah
outcome.answer: Babban tasha ba kamar sauran ba

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
